rules.prompt: Review merge request !{number} in {repo}: {url}. Use glab or the GitLab API to inspect the current diff and existing discussions. Report actionable findings on changed lines and avoid duplicate reviews for the same head SHA.

Implement GitLab issue #{number} in {repo}: {url}. Requested by {requester}. Read the issue and project instructions. Use glab or the GitLab API to check for an existing merge request, then implement, test, commit, push, and open a merge request that closes the issue. Report its URL.

Review GitLab merge request !{number} in {repo}: {url}. Requested by {requester}. Use glab or the GitLab API to inspect the current head SHA, diff, and existing discussions; post one review for that SHA.

Address review feedback on GitLab merge request !{number} in {repo}: {url}. Requested by {requester}. Use glab or the GitLab API to inspect discussions, fix valid findings, test, commit, push, and reply to threads. Report the merge request URL.
